Mobile gaming expertise - You’ll have prior experience in mobile gaming and have shipped at least one title from concept through to launch and live operations, as well as one major update.

Communication & Clarity -  You’re a confident communicator at all levels, and  keep everyone aligned through good comms, reliable documentation and proactive updates.

Project experience in karaoke/music apps or rhythm games
Experience working in small companies and startup environments

A keen interest in karaoke/singing/music, user behaviour or making things players love

Own the plan, pace, and structure of delivery ensuring fast, aligned execution across all disciplines (code, designers, artists, QA, etc). Turn product intent into team action enabling fast, focused execution across both new ideas and live game features.
